## Core Specialities & Signature Treatments
1. **Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser (1064 nm / 532 nm):**
   - Indication: Melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), sun spots, freckles, tattoo removal, and laser skin toning.
   - Clinical Protocol: Low-fluence, multiple-pass toning calibrated specifically for Indian Fitzpatrick skin types IV–VI to avoid paradoxical rebound hyperpigmentation.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/q-switched-laser-melasma-pigmentation-bangalore/

2. **HydraFacial Skin Rejuvenation:**
   - Indication: Dullness, dehydrated skin, congested pores, rough texture, and pre-event radiance.
   - Technology: Vortex-Fusion hydradermabrasion combining exfoliation, vacuum extraction, and antioxidant/hyaluronic acid serum infusion.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/hydrafacial-bangalore/

3. **Combination Synergy Protocol (Laser + HydraFacial):**
   - Sequential pairing of deep vortex hydradermabrasion (pre-conditioning) with low-fluence Q-switched laser toning spaced 2–4 weeks apart.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatment-comparison/

4. **Acne & Acne Scar Revision:**
   - Modalities: Subcision for tethered scars, Microneedling Radiofrequency (MNRF), Chemical Peels, and Fractional lasers.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/skin-treatments

5. **Laser Hair Reduction:**
   - Technology: US-FDA approved Diode Laser (808–810 nm) with integrated sapphire contact cooling for painless treatment on South Asian skin tones.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/laser-treatments

6. **Trichology & Hair Restoration:**
   - Modalities: Growth Factor Therapy (GFT), Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), and clinical alopecia management.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/hair-treatments

## Clinical Ethics & Guidelines
- All consultations and diagnostic skin examinations are performed directly by Dr. Sujay M.
- Strict compliance with National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations. No exaggerated or misleading "permanent cure" promises for chronic conditions such as melasma.
- Melasma is treated as a manageable, hormonally influenced condition requiring daily broad-spectrum sun protection, topical tyrosinase inhibitors, and low-fluence laser therapy when indicated.
